items.title_zh: Cisco SEG RCE 在野利用
items.summary_zh: 遠端攻擊者可寫入檔案並以 root 權限執行指令。
items.fix_hint: 更新至 Cisco 發布的最新軟體版本。
items.desc_en:
Cisco Secure Email Gateway Arbitrary File Write Vulnerability

A vulnerability in the Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

This vulnerability is due to improper handling of email attachments when the file reputation service is enabled. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending an email that contains a crafted attachment through an affected device. items.fix_hint: 升級 Podman 至修復版本。
items.desc_en:
Podman: The `podman run` command can be instructed to disable almost all sandboxing by image annotation
### Impact
Podman v4.4.0 added a feature where container checkpoints (from the `podman container checkpoint` command) could be distributed via OCI registry, and pulled from that registry and run via the `podman run` command. This allowed easy transfer of checkpoints between systems. However, checkpoints allow complete control of how the container is created - including full control of the container sandbox. items.title_zh: Argo CD 資源限制繞過
items.summary_zh: 攻擊者可利用資源掛鉤繞過 AppProject 命名空間限制。
items.fix_hint: 升級至 v2.10.x 或更高修復版本。
items.desc_en:
Argo CD: AppProject destination-namespace and resource restrictions bypassed by PreDelete/PostDelete resource hooks
### Impact

Argo CD checks an Application's AppProject before it creates resources during a sync. That check covers destination namespaces and servers, cluster-scoped resource allow and deny lists, and namespaced resource allow and deny lists, including resource names. KEDA: Privilege escalation from namespace admin to cluster admin via KEDA TriggerAuthentication
